decision: Sam's explicit decision of 2026-11-05 in Claude Code session f804490c: "全部批准，我作為project owner 批準你發digest，CI綠了就merge", answering the consolidated proposal for TASK-021 (1 new client test file with 8 case definitions running 10 times, the unchanged re-pin of the TASK-019 and TASK-020 cases and pins invalidated by the list page change, and a support pin for menu.js), and a one-time project-owner authorization for the agent to publish this receipt's digest
purpose: The Purchasing menu group appears only with purchasing.view and holds only the PO list, unfinished pages have no entry, every Purchasing error code has a Traditional Chinese message, shared messages do not misdirect Purchasing users, and HttpClient keeps the code and falls back safely on unknown codes; the TASK-019 and TASK-020 page behaviour stays pinned
data: No database or network: real discovered pages, mocked services and fetch, and small inline objects, at most 100 in-memory lines. The error test imports the server's purchasingErrors.js table without starting a server. No fixture files
thresholds: All cases pass; coverage floors unchanged
trigger: Routine correctness regression on every PR and push to main, in the existing client test job
cost: Measured locally: about 5 ms for the new file and about 0.6 s for the re-pinned files. CI not measured, estimated under 1 s added. No new job and no capacity
